# bubbletea and android show one window: a terminal is one screen and an
# activity one content view. A second window is refused at the second, where
# it used to be dropped without a word -- including one in the other branch
# of an `if`, which is still a second window the program says exists. A
# program wanting several screens on one surface wants a navigator (`sngl:ui/nav`).
# gtk4 builds the same source, two toplevels.

! sngl generate --lang go --platform bubbletea -o tea two.sngl
stderr 'two.sngl:9:15: bubbletea shows one window, and this is a second; the first is at two.sngl:5:16'

! sngl generate --lang kotlin --platform android -o droid two.sngl
stderr 'two.sngl:9:15: android shows one window, and this is a second; the first is at two.sngl:5:16'

! sngl generate --lang go --platform bubbletea -o tea2 branches.sngl
stderr 'branches.sngl:10:14: bubbletea shows one window, and this is a second; the first is at branches.sngl:6:14'

! sngl generate --lang go --platform bubbletea -o tea3 loop.sngl
stderr 'loop.sngl:6:14: bubbletea shows one window, and a `for` makes a copy of this one per element'

# A context provider puts nothing in the tree, so a window under one is still
# a second window.
! sngl generate --lang go --platform bubbletea -o tea4 provided.sngl
stderr 'provided.sngl:10:14: bubbletea shows one window, and this is a second; the first is at provided.sngl:5:10'

sngl generate --lang go --platform gtk4 -o gtk4 two.sngl
sngl generate --lang go --platform bubbletea -o one one.sngl

-- two.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"

var n = 0

ui.window #main(title="Main") {
    ui.text(value="{n}")
}

ui.window #log(title="Log") {
    ui.text(value="log")
}
-- provided.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"

context #theme("light")

ui.window(title="Main") {
    ui.text(value="main")
}

theme("dark") {
    ui.window(title="Log") {
        ui.text(value="log")
    }
}
-- branches.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"

var wide = false

if wide {
    ui.window(title="Wide") {
        ui.text(value="wide")
    }
} else {
    ui.window(title="Narrow") {
        ui.text(value="narrow")
    }
}
-- loop.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"

var names = ["a", "b"]

for var name = names {
    ui.window(title=name) {
        ui.text(value=name)
    }
}
-- one.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"

ui.window #main(title="Main") {
    ui.text(value="one")
}
